description: Advisory workflow hooks for the ForgeMind plugin.

hooks.name: before-project-work
hooks.purpose: Build a compact repository profile before planning unfamiliar work.

hooks.name: help-menu
hooks.purpose: Show ForgeMind commands, modes, skill menu, and usage examples.

hooks.name: before-feature-work
hooks.purpose: Route ambiguous coding requests through intent, risk, plan, implementation, and verification.

hooks.name: workflow-init
hooks.purpose: Initialize project profile, memory, verification baseline, and next workflow action.

hooks.name: workflow-status
hooks.purpose: Report phase, mode, active skill, progress, blockers, verification, and next action.

hooks.name: skill-router-confidence
hooks.purpose: Recommend the best ForgeMind skill with confidence, alternatives, risk level, and next action.

hooks.name: workflow-graph
hooks.purpose: Show the ForgeMind workflow graph from idea through release and learning.

hooks.name: agent-menu
hooks.purpose: Show available ForgeMind specialist agents and recommend a role.

hooks.name: prd-builder
hooks.purpose: Create a concise, buildable product requirements document.

hooks.name: epic-story-builder
hooks.purpose: Convert product scope into epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation order.

hooks.name: scrum-master-agent
hooks.purpose: Prepare stories, tasks, blockers, and development handoff.

hooks.name: story-status
hooks.purpose: Report story, epic, backlog, or feature status.

hooks.name: acceptance-criteria-builder
hooks.purpose: Create acceptance criteria, test cases, definition of done, and verification checklist.

hooks.name: before-autopilot-work
hooks.purpose: Inspect, route, decide, act, verify, learn, and report with minimal questions.

hooks.name: before-innovation-first-work
hooks.purpose: Read app structure first, then produce radical AI/KI ideas and maximum USP proposals before build planning.

hooks.name: before-product-feature
hooks.purpose: Surface useful USP and AI/KI leverage before building user-facing features.

hooks.name: usp-backlog
hooks.purpose: Store and prioritize AI/KI USP ideas with score, experiment, status, and evidence.

hooks.name: before-radical-feature
hooks.purpose: Generate radical AI/KI 10x feature concepts and a build-ready vibe-coding MVP.

hooks.name: before-app-evolution
hooks.purpose: Review code, propose optimizations, generate six feasible feature ideas, implement one feature, and verify it.

hooks.name: before-autonomous-work
hooks.purpose: Apply explicit autonomy boundaries before end-to-end feature work.

hooks.name: before-completion
hooks.purpose: Confirm tests, diffs, and residual risk before reporting completion.

hooks.name: gap-scanner
hooks.purpose: Scan for missing release, quality, documentation, CI, packaging, traceability, and runtime evidence.

hooks.name: release-readiness-score
hooks.purpose: Score release readiness using verification, CI, docs, traceability, security, runtime, and handoff evidence.

hooks.name: risk-radar
hooks.purpose: Detect implementation, release, security, dependency, migration, generated-file, and handoff risks.

hooks.name: rollback-planner
hooks.purpose: Generate rollback, recovery, and release fallback steps.

hooks.name: pr-summary-builder
hooks.purpose: Generate PR or handoff summaries from changed files, verification, gaps, readiness, risks, and rollback evidence.

hooks.name: traceability-mapper
hooks.purpose: Map PRD goals, stories, acceptance criteria, code changes, and verification evidence.

hooks.name: runtime-discovery-test
hooks.purpose: Check installed plugin discovery through cache, marketplace, config, skills, and hooks.

hooks.name: command-center
hooks.purpose: Refresh the ForgeMind command center dashboard with status, gaps, readiness, memory, traceability, and USP backlog.

hooks.name: before-tdd-work
hooks.purpose: Use red-green-refactor for test-first implementation where practical.

hooks.name: finish-branch
hooks.purpose: Prepare final verification, release notes, changed file summary, and handoff.

hooks.name: after-substantial-work
hooks.purpose: Capture durable decisions, conventions, verification commands, risk zones, and USP ideas.

hooks.name: after-learning-signal
hooks.purpose: Capture mistakes, preferences, patterns, feedback, and self-update proposals.

hooks.name: outcome-memory
hooks.purpose: Record outcome evidence for completed work, failed checks, release decisions, and routing effectiveness.

hooks.name: verification-registry
hooks.purpose: Maintain known-good verification commands, confidence, and last result.

hooks.name: decision-log
hooks.purpose: Record architecture, product, scope, release, and workflow decisions.

hooks.name: learning-to-skill-patch
hooks.purpose: Convert repeated failures and review findings into concrete ForgeMind self-update patch proposals.

hooks.name: differentiation-matrix
hooks.purpose: Compare ForgeMind capabilities with relevant market baselines and alternatives.

hooks.name: before-self-update
hooks.purpose: Review and apply approved ForgeMind self-update proposals.
